svg.text: colored chip = one shard (S/N bytes) · Σ = reduced (summed) shard · wide bar = full tensor (S bytes)
root sends the full tensor to everyone · 1 → N
root deals one shard to each rank · 1 → N
every rank sends its shard to root · N → 1
everyone ends up with all shards · N → N
shard k gets summed across ranks, lands on rank k · N → N
= reduce-scatter + all-gather · everyone gets the full sum
